panel.keys: ↑↓ move · Space switch · A all · R refresh · ←→ tabs
conn.unauthorized: The bridge no longer accepts this app. Pair again.
conn.certChanged: The bridge's certificate changed. Only trust it if you reset the bridge or replaced it.
conn.unpaired: Not paired with a bridge yet.
error.timeout: The bridge took too long to answer.
error.rateLimited: The bridge is busy. Try again in a moment.
error.notABridge: Something answered at that address, but it isn't a Hue bridge.
zone.explain: A zone groups lights from any rooms, so one switch or scene can drive them together.
zone.deleteConfirm: Click again to delete this zone
wallpaper.title: Wallpaper sync
wallpaper.onCaption: Colour lights follow your wallpaper, and update when it changes. Brightness is left alone.
wallpaper.offCaption: Paint your colour lights with the wallpaper's colours.
wallpaper.hintNoColourLights: There are no colour lights in the selected rooms. Pick other rooms.
wallpaper.hintNoneOn: No colour lights are on in the selected rooms. Turn on '%1' or pick other rooms.
wallpaper.noPalette: No palette could be read from the wallpaper. Is ImageMagick (`magick`) installed?
scenes.saveTitle: Save current look as a scene
automations.title: Automations
automations.streamingNote: Streaming (Sync box, Hue Sync) is started by the app doing the streaming.
devices.forgetConfirm: Click again to forget this bridge
pairing.pressButton: Press the round link button on top of the bridge.

pairing.pressButtonLeft.one: Press the round link button on top of the bridge (%1s left).
pairing.pressButtonLeft.other: Press the round link button on top of the bridge (%1s left).

pairing.noAnswer: No bridge answered at that address. Check the IP address and that this computer is on the same network.
pairing.timedOut: The link button wasn't pressed in time. Try again.
pairing.badHost: That isn't an IP address or host name.
pairing.discoveryFailed: Couldn't reach Philips' discovery service. Type the bridge's IP address instead.
pairing.noneFound: No bridges found. Type the bridge's IP address instead (your router's list of devices shows it).
recovery.title: Can't reach your bridge
recovery.explain: The bridge may be off or disconnected, or its IP address may have changed (a new DHCP lease). Retry, or forget it and pair again at its new address.
